notes.title: Football Manager 2020 Touch February Transfer Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35719542/69c8de20a92056cdb6d1486a2d160c91eff1083c.jpg

With the February transfer window now closed we're happy to announce that Update 20.4.0 is now available for Football Manager 2020 Touch. 

The update should download automatically, but if you find it hasn't updated, we'd suggest restarting Steam. If you’re unsure whether the game is on the latest version, you can see the version number on the main menu of the game in the bottom-left hand corner.

For access to database and competition updates you'll be required to start a new game, but for all other fixes you're fine to continue any pre-existing saves. 

20.4.0 Update Changes including (but not limited to):
----------------------------------
- Further database updates covering February transfer window.
- Stability fixes.
- UI fixes and improvements.
- Competition tweaks and updates across a number of leagues.
- Tweaks to lighting for matches and Newgen faces.
- Fixed rare instance of tactical change not completing during match.

notes.title: Football Manager 2020 Touch Winter Update – January Transfers
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35719542/a15de6a5a5ddf92c27ef5296b74e7442173f7db2.jpg
It was a big January window for wonderkid transfers, and you can now play with the teams who bagged the very best of them or start your own quest to find the next crop of superstars ready to burst onto the world stage.

Winter Update 20.3.0 features all the latest signings and squads from the January Transfer Window. The February data update will follow shortly after the closure of this window on February 29th. Data updates will only appear in newly started careers and will not affect existing save games.

As well as the latest transfers your team may also benefit from tweaked and improved player ratings as determined by our scouting team who have been busy, as always, analysing and assessing performances in the first half of the season.

Restart Steam now to get the update or purchase Football Manager 2020 Touch to see if your team has been improved.

As well as data revisions, managers will also benefit from a number of gameplay improvements – some of the highlights include:

- Added 20.3 database which includes up-to-date transfers from January transfer window.
- Numerous stability improvements and crash fixes.
- Improvements to game optimisation and increased performance both inside and outside of matches.
- Numerous competition and rule changes.
- Numerous UI improvements.
- Improvements to contract negotiations.
- Improvements to Club Vision and expectations logic.
- Balance changes to Board and Fan confidence.
- News and inbox item improvements.
- Adjusted pass and fail conditions in Challenges.
- Improvements to player happiness with training, particularly for goalkeepers.
- Fixed occasional divergence when using Instant Result.
- Fixes for unlockables, including Design a Son not unlocking through gameplay.
- Cross-Sync now functional with iPadOS 13+.

Get FM20 Touch now and begin creating your football story today.

notes.title: Football Manager 2020 Touch Match Engine Update 20.2.4 Out Now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35719542/342fd17c3466467a24a4e37cbcff2db0816ac38a.jpg

We’re pleased to announce we’ve released Update 20.2.4 which, alongside some performance optimisation, includes an updated match engine containing a number of tweaks, improvements and changes. 

As always, this update is save game compatible and the next time you log onto Steam it’ll automatically update. You can see the version number of Football Manager Touch in the bottom left-hand corner of the main menu. If for whatever reason you find the game hasn’t updated, we’d recommend restarting Steam.

20.2.4 Changelist
-----------------------
- Performance and optimisation improvements

Various Match Engine (version 2039) changes including (but not limited to):

- Improved one-on-one finishing
- Recalculations regarding clear-cut chances
- Tweaks to penalty kick conversion rates
- Lowered frequency of players overrunning ball and losing possession
- Improved realism of player recoveries from slide tackles
- Improved crossing variation and instruction behaviour
- Improved defensive tracking from long balls
- Improved heading accuracy 
- Improvements/tweaks to referee behaviour
- Throw-in positional adjustments 
- Various other balancing tweaks/improvements

notes.title: Football Manager 2020 gets November release date on PC and mobile devices
notes.notes: Sports Interactive has announced that this year's iteration of Football Manager, better known as Football Manager 2020, will be coming to Steam and mobile devices on 19th November.According to the developer, three versions of the game will be launching on the same day; the full-fat Football Manager 2020 will be available on Steam, while Football Manager 2020 Touch (described as a more streamlined version, "only focusing on the core responsibilities that a manager would have") launches on Steam, iOS and Android. Lastly, Football Manager 2020 Mobile will release on iOS and Android only.Sports Interactive also notes that Football Manager launch dates for Switch (which will be getting the Touch version of the game) and Stadia are "coming soon".Read more
